Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Stage Layout Pet Stage Preview: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a stage layout featuring live animated pet previews and interactive playfulness. (why: Adoption has a steep drop-off (60.9% conversion, median 89s). A full visual redesign makes selecting a pet engaging and immediate.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Quick Control Interactive Walkthrough: Add a new screen 'new_control_walkthrough' right after rendering waiting to teach essential pet tray controls before finishing. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding how to control, hide, or interact with the pet after onboarding completes.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Photo Quality Check Flow: Add photo validation feedback and real-time live preview state on the upload_photos screen during custom pet creation. (why: Support received reports that making a custom pet fails or the generated pet outcome looks distorted.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight Layout Path Switcher: Switch choose_path screen layout to spotlight mode with high-contrast path feature cards. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s despite median 8s, indicating some users stall on path choice.)
4: [adoption, incentive] Official Adoption Certificate Stamp Incentive: Add an official animated seal badge and adoption milestone incentive on adoption_certificate. (why: Adoption stage experiences steep drop-off (60.9% conversion); clear completion reward increases user momentum.)
5: [home, wait_info] Background Render Progress Wait Notification: Enable time estimates and progress indicators during the desktop pet initialization wait screen. (why: Users take median 201s / mean 2336s on waiting, and some report pets failing to appear on desktop.)
6: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Tray Docking Guide: Update home_intro text and hint to clearly explain how to access desktop pet options via system tray. (why: Multiple support emails complain about inability to locate pet controls or interact after initial setup.)
